name: fomor
description: A local exploration assistant for Trae: observe the questions you ask your agent, understand what you are really trying to do, and surface solution paths you have not considered. No model configuration needed.

interface.shortDescription: Daily exploration of new solution paths, built from the questions you already ask your agent
interface.longDescription: Fomor collects the questions you send in Trae through a lightweight hook (no prompt injection, no session interference). Once a day, the Trae automation agent follows the bundled SOP: it understands what you are working on and why, identifies potential knowledge, method, tool, workflow, solution and perspective gaps, evaluates which explorations are actually worth pursuing, then researches and validates new methods, tools, workflows and real cases. The result is an exploration directory — a short list of directions worth your attention, each with an optional detail page — delivered through the automation conversation. It never repeats what a normal AI conversation would already give you, never infers refusal from silence (you can explicitly mark content as unwanted by invoking the skill), and never injects content into your sessions.
defaultPrompt: Set up Fomor for this workspace
